Subject: Fjord renewal: capacity bump and pricing for next year

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well. Our usage has accelerated faster than expected this quarter — attached is our May usage summary. We’re planning a renewal in late June and are considering a capacity bump (estimated +35% token consumption, plus two extra inference nodes for peak periods).

Key asks from procurement:
- Can you hold current pricing for the first 3 months of the renewal term while we ramp?
- What level of discount can Redwood offer if we commit to a 12‑month term at ~1.3x our current committed volume?
- Any bridge credit or onboarding credit to cover unexpected overages during the ramp?

Timelines: procurement needs a commercial summary for internal review by June 10. Happy to do a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Emily Stanton
Head of Platform
Fjord Retail

Hi Emily — thanks for the data, this is helpful. Congrats on the growth — looks like the ramp is real. I can move quickly here and get a commercial summary over for procurement by June 10.

High level options I want to surface before our call:
- 12‑month commit at 1.3x current committed volume: we can offer a 12% base discount off list and a $40k bridge credit applied to the first two invoices to absorb ramp overages.
- Short‑term price hold: we can guarantee current list pricing for the first 3 months of the renewal provided the 12‑month commit is signed. That gives you breathing room while the extra nodes spin up.
- Alternate: if you prefer month‑to‑month flexibility, we can do a smaller discount (6–8%) and a prorated bridge credit tied to true‑up.

If that aligns with what procurement needs, I’ll loop in Marissa (your AE) and Ben from finance to draft a concise amendment and commercial summary. Can you do a 30‑min call on Wednesday (Jun 3) 10–10:30am PT?

—Hannah

- Term: 12 months (starts on executed date)
- Commit: 1.30x current committed volume (baseline from May usage)
- Discount: 12% off list for committed usage

Can you have a one‑pager and the drafted amendment back to me by EOD Wed (June 3)? I’ll join the call with Fjord and take the commercial through procurement.

Hi Emily (and Amit / procurement team),

Thanks again for the call yesterday — good alignment on ramp timing and the June 30 renewal target. Below is the commercial summary Redwood recommends to balance predictability for Fjord and capacity planning for us. This is intentionally concise for procurement review.

Commercial summary (Option A — recommended):
- Term: 12 months (effective on signature)
- Commit: 130% of current committed volume (baseline = avg May 2026 consumption)
- Discount: 12% off list pricing for committed usage
- Bridge credit: $40,000 credited across first two invoices to cover early ramp overages
- Price hold: current list pricing guaranteed for first 3 months of the term (provided commitment is executed)
- True‑up cadence: quarterly true‑up; overage rates apply after credits are exhausted
- Operational SLA/Onboarding: 30‑ and 60‑day check‑ins to confirm node provisioning and perf tuning

If you prefer more runway we can instead do Option B (flex): 12‑month term with 6% discount, $20k prorated credit, no price hold. Let me know which you prefer — A is our recommendation to give you cost certainty while we provision additional capacity.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the Draft_Amendment_v1.docx for your review.
2) If procurement is comfortable, I’ll send the final amendment via DocuSign for signature (link below).
3) Once executed we’ll schedule the 30‑day onboarding check and kick off the node provisioning.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/signature/placeholder/DEAL-2026-0417
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2026-0417

Open questions I flagged for legal/procurement: data retention SOW for logs during the onboarding period; invoice timing for bridge credit application (we propose apply 50% of credit to first invoice, 50% to second). Happy to capture any redlines you have.

If that all looks acceptable, can procurement confirm by June 10 and we’ll issue the DocuSign?
